_about: Made-up scripted Generator replies for DA_LLM_PROVIDER=fake in Approach (spec 11). They follow the Excel example and the pretend index. A file or a reuse decision names the Discover hits it cites by symbol (or path, for a whole-file piece) in 'cites'; the fake client turns these into the hit numbers of the prompt it is given. The typed text is ignored.
